The derivations through differentiated gauge invariance and curvature transport sit in helper lemmas (`column_price`, `Wilson_stream`, `veneer`) that I did not trace, and the vertices are indexed by derivative order, not degree.

lemma greyson (G : Gauge) (σ ε C Z τ A : ℝ) (hs : 0<σ) (hC : 0≤C) (hZ : 0≤Z) (hτ : 0<τ) (hA : 0≤A) : ∃ s M,0<s ∧ 0≤M ∧ ∀ (m : ℕ→ Side), Tendsto (fun i => (m i).val) atTop atTop → ∀ (B : Bed) (p : Clip) (R : PathData G) Λ, R.Bounds p τ A Λ → Attached B R → B.metric.strip σ C → p.direct ≤ Z → (∀ n,Floor B p n ε C) → (∀ i,Bid.Sworn B (m i) G) →
    ∀ i, i>0 → i≤3 → Drinkable i m (fun i => intended (m:=m i) p R-WilsonQ G (m i)) (4-i) s M := by

proof_context.conclusion: `greyson`: for `i = 1,2,3` the fine-minus-Wilson series `intended - WilsonQ` is `Drinkable i … (4-i)`, i.e. its degree `i+1` vertex has jet order `4-i` (3, 2, 1 for degrees 2, 3, 4).

snippet.text: lemma whiteWilson (G : Gauge) : ∃ B:ℝ,0≤B ∧ ∀ (m : ℕ→Side), Tendsto (fun i=> (m i).val) atTop atTop → ∀ k, k>0 → k≤3 → Drinkable k m (fun i => WilsonQ G (m i)) (3-k) 1 B := by

proof_context.conclusion: `whiteWilson`: the Wilson vertices of `WilsonQ` are `Drinkable k … (3-k)`, i.e. order 2, 1, 0 for degrees 2, 3, 4.
`top_Wilson`: `WilsonQ - inputSeries` has `Rays 3`, the quadratic level using the diagonal `acts = 1` (`Ĥ(0) = I`) and `faceCurl`.

lemma setWest (G : Gauge) (w η Q Z D ε : ℝ) (hσ : 0<w) (hη : 0<η) (hw : η ≤ 1) (hz : 0≤Z) (hQ : 0≤Q)
    (J : ℕ) (K : KernelChoices) : ∃ a b : ℝ, 0≤a ∧ 0≤b ∧ ∀ σ A, 0<σ → 0 ≤ A → ∃ σ' ℓ r:ℝ, 0 < σ' ∧ 0≤ℓ ∧ 0≤r ∧ ∀ (m n : ℕ→Side), Tendsto (fun i => (n i).val) atTop atTop → ∀ (p : Clip) (R : PathData G) (B : Bed) (Λ : ℝ), p.direct ≤ Z → R.Bounds p σ A Λ → Attached B R → B.metric.strip w Q → (∀ i, Floor B p i ε Q) → (∀ i, Bid.Sworn B (n i) G) →
      ∀ (P : Patch), P.J=J → P.Branches K G → inch P.L*η ≤ σ' → ∀ (F : Armada m n P K) (t : ∀ i,(F.boot i).Choices) (Φ : Bridge G P), Cruise Φ 2 η D →
    ∃ T : TextS 3 P G, ∃ U : TextS 4 P G, Pungent T η ∧ Pungent U η ∧ Laureate T Φ η (a+inch P.L*ℓ) ∧ Laureate U Φ η (b+inch P.L*r) ∧ ∀ i, Skimming (F.boot i) T (centR (F.boot i) (t i) p R) ∧ Skimming (F.boot i) U (centR (F.boot i) (t i) p R) := by

proof_context.conclusion: `setWest` gives the vertices bounds `a + inch P.L * ℓ` and `b + inch P.L * r` with `a, b` independent of the input bound `A`, i.e. `C_3 ≤ a_3 + ℓ⁻¹ a_3'`, `C_4 ≤ c_4 + ℓ⁻¹ c_4'`.
